svg.aria-label: AIWorkHub Source Graph architecture: a daemon-driven refresh control, a five-stage write path of discover, triage, extract, merge and resolve, a repository-local SQLite index of entities, edges and full-text rows, and a five-stage read path of bind, retrieve, rank, bound and receipt that feeds focused semantic edits and the review overlay.
svg.text: One repository-local SQLite graph. The write path turns files into bounded structural evidence; the read path answers a model from that evidence instead of re-scanning the tree.
REFRESH CONTROL · source_graph_daemon.py — one daemon per resolved repository root
wait loop with a floor, never a filesystem hook
an index build never blocks the MCP loop
a scan cannot starve the interactive server
stopped indexing ready empty standby degraded stale
which files may enter the index at all
an oversized policy is refused, not truncated
revision + size + mtime_ns + extractor set must match
stat / read / stat — pre must equal post
returns None → routed to full extraction
parse each file, touching no database
the single entry point for every adapter
python ast · tree-sitter JS/TS · polyglot · cpp · php
module namespace class struct enum macro fn method …
exactly one writer touches the database
a torn file cannot poison the generation
vanished and renamed paths dropped, not stranded
bind across files, then grade the generation
cpp + JS/TS always; python binder only for .py
>1 candidate → AMBIGUOUS, never attached to a guess
git log 90d --numstat — at index time only
aiworkhub.source_graph.v1 · aiworkhub.source_graph.semantic.v6 · this repository right now: 1,051 files · 56,875 entities · 388,370 edges · 10 languages
no global database, no cross-repository graph
every row stamped with the build revision
retrieval is lexical, ranking is graph-derived
history is materialised, never computed per query
which database may answer, and for whom
no tool argument names a repo, database or task
find candidates without scanning the tree
phrase-prefix → tokens AND → tokens OR · first wins
exact qualname → exact name → name prefix → rest
review overlay: partition schemas first, base last
deterministic, from the graph — no model
COUNT(*) on edges kind='calls' by dst_ and src_qualname
regex over a bounded slice of the symbol body
focus/slice first, escalate only from returned evidence
every answer is row- and byte-capped
re-clamped inside find(), not trusted from callers
orientation 8 KiB · analysis 12 KiB · default 16 KiB
truncated / next_cursor — never a silent short answer
prefetch | live | cache — injected never counts as live
workflow_stage per call · a green card can be refused
WHAT THE INDEX BUYS · THE TWO CONSUMERS
fragment + sha256(whole file) + sha256(fragment) — nothing is written
re-reads from disk and re-hashes: a stale range is refused, not merged
allowed_writes fnmatch · symlink walk · containment · UTF-8 · size cap
assembled offline, then mkstemp + fsync + os.replace in one step
file_bytes · old_region_bytes · replacement_bytes — bytes, not a token claim
indexes only the review packet's changed_paths, fresh database
marker 'composed_view' pins the base by {db_path, size, mtime_ns}
the partition auto-attaches the base with ?mode=ro; base stays main
partitions UNION ALL base WHERE file_path NOT IN temp._partition_scope
PartitionBaseShiftError — stale evidence is never served
